prompt: What are the lyrics to the popular, unofficial fight song of the university that the main character of Gilmore Girls attended?
answer:
The song is **“Boola Boola,”** Yale University’s popular unofficial fight song—the university Rory Gilmore attends.

> Boola boola, boola boola  
> Boola boola, boola boola  
> When we rough house poor old Hahvahd

> Oh Yale, Eli Yale!  
> Oh Yale, Eli Yale!  
> Oh Yale, Eli Yale!  
> Oh Yale, Eli Yale!
